title: What are People Talking about in #BlackLivesMatter and #StopAsianHate? Exploring and Categorizing Twitter Topics Emerging in Online Social Movements through the Latent Dirichlet Allocation Model
reasoning: The paper analyzes social movements related to racism and social justice using Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) to categorize Twitter discourse. While it discusses topics of justice and fairness in the context of online social movements and was presented at an ethics-focused conference, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious, moral, or ethical reasoning or systems within an AI model or NLP system.
